place_relation: at foot of bluff, west side
notes: Report's own numbering: STATION 89 (top right). Faint typescript: the second digit of the latitude minutes is hard to read (read as 28; could be 29). Altitude about 100 feet, from topographic map. Description: Seepage collected in shallow ditch at foot of bluff, west side Refugio Creek. Discharge measured at end of 2-inch pipe to stock trough. Three dated rows (Dec. 2, 1948; Jan. 21, 1949; Mar. 28), each in second-feet and gals. per min. No basin, county or state printed.
